verse.text: When these celebrations ended—sometimes after several days—Job would purify his children. He would get up early in the morning and offer a burnt offering for each of them.

video.title: Praying for your Children (Job 1:5) - Short Devotional Series

reflection: Job didn't wait for his kids to mess up before he prayed for them — he got up early, on his own initiative, and interceded for each one by name. That's the picture of a dad's job: not just correcting problems after they happen, but covering your family in prayer before the day even starts. A few quiet minutes each morning asking God to guard your kids' hearts does more for your household than you'll ever see on the surface.
